issues.description: GH-512 batch 2b commit c8b79467 introduced a compile error in tests/integration/ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig:411: 'no field named subscription_id_slice in struct api.routes.webhooks.HandlerResult'. The HandlerResult struct (src/api/routes/webhooks.zig:10-13) only has fields status_code: u16 and body: []const u8. The diff vs origin/main is 92 lines. This blocks compilation of the ext02 test module and prevents 12 tests from running.
